Woodlands — Coventry, United Kingdom

🟢 Official crime data · West Midlands Police, data.police.uk Methodology →

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

West Midlands Police recorded 351 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — an average of 6.6 per 1,000 residents a month, the 13th highest rate of Coventry's 18 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (7), vehicle crime (7), burglary (5); the evening/night score by violent crime (58), anti social behaviour (12), public order (5). Those two scores are split by offence type, not by clock time — the police feed records no time of day, so day and night here mean the kinds of crime typical of each, not counts of incidents observed then. Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Woodlands safe?

Wandroz currently rates Woodlands in Coventry as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Coventry during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Coventry at night. This rating is derived from West Midlands Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Woodlands safe at night?

At night, Woodlands is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Coventry. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Woodlands a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Woodlands's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Coventry) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Note that the Booking.com link on this page searches Coventry, not Woodlands specifically: Booking does not list this neighbourhood as a destination of its own, so check each property's address against the map above.

Is there official crime data for Woodlands?

Yes. Woodlands's rating is derived from West Midlands Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk, not an assessment — see the note on this page for the exact figure and the methodology page for full sourcing.
